description: This file contains unit tests for the tenantClient utility functions, including normalization of tenant IDs, fetching session tenants, selecting a tenant, and setting the active tenant. It uses Jest for testing and mocks fetch and localStorage interactions.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes tenant identifiers from various input shapes to a string or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches tenants associated with the current session.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant, posts to the server, and updates local storage.

methods.name: getActiveTenant
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active tenant from storage.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant in local storage, replacing legacy keys.
